acceptance_gates.title: Whole-list copy ceilings come from rules and the existing hypergeometric helper
verify: For the Carpet Set G s60 fixture, GET /api/decks/{id}/fate/ceilings (or the in-process lab tool) returns per-name copies, copy cap 4, and P(at least one) at the active opening hand size, equal to draw_probability for the same name within 1e-9.
A 4-copy name reports a higher P(at least one) than a 1-copy name; a name absent from the list is absent or P = 0.
Under a 30-card preset the same endpoint reports deck size 30 and that preset's copy cap; no literal 60 or 4 appears in app/engine/game.py from this slice.

With a printed +3 draw operator present, the response includes effective_seen = opening_hand + 3 and a P(at least one) at that count; for a 1-of the delta over the opening-hand figure equals 3/60 within 1e-6, for a 4-of it exceeds 3/60.

acceptance_gates.title: KG edges exist only where printed parse supports them
verify: For a fixture containing Clefairy LOR 62, the KG has an attach_energy_from_deck_per_benched edge from Clefairy to Psychic Energy with no look-N attribute.

Ledian's printed Glittering Star Pattern sentence parses to the same hook kind as Boss's Orders (force_opponent_active) with trigger on_evolve and max_remaining_hp 90; the test uses the exact printed wording.
A printing with no search/draw/tutor/evolve/named-partner text has zero non-energy edges; adding a data/lab/*.md note does not change the edge set.
Human: on http://127.0.0.1:8000 (or chat), asking why two cards are linked returns the printed sentence that created the edge.

acceptance_gates.title: Deck KG carries print-derived node metrics, dependence, energy budget, and junk flags
verify: Two fixture printings with the same attack cost and 50 vs 100 damage report lead damage_per_energy 25 vs 50; the 100-damage node ranks higher with no name table in app/engine/game.py.
Mega Clefable ex reports min damage_per_energy 60 (0 discards) and max 140 (4 discards) and warm_up_turns 2 at attach rate 1.
For 4 Ledyba / 4 Ledian the line reports charges 4 and stranded false; 3 Ledyba / 4 Ledian reports charges 3 and stranded true; 4 Ledyba / 3 Ledian reports charges 3 and stranded false.
Energy budget reports Psychic supply separately from Darkness and Boomerang; a [P][P] attacker is not marked payable by Colorless special Energy.
A fixture printing with only generic energy-pay edges is flagged isolated; a printing on an evolve line or with a printed tutor/partner is not.
Human: the quality / junk explanation is readable (cost, damage, links, dependence).

acceptance_gates.title: Delta-S ranks 1-for-1 swaps without Monte Carlo and explains per ecology
verify: POST /api/decks/{id}/fate/swaps with add = Mega Clefable ex on the Carpet Set G fixture returns one row per distinct cut with net delta_s and a per-ecology breakdown, in under 2 seconds and without calling run_simulation.
The row for cutting Ledian ranks above the row for cutting Ledyba, and its explanation cites dependence (bodies vs evolutions).
The row for cutting Clefairy ranks below the row for cutting Ledian and cites the added Mega's body dependence and Party charges.

Ecology weights are loaded from data (preset default plus optional trainer overlay); posting a different early_equal_hands weight changes the rank of the conditional 170/2 attacker, and the response echoes the weights used.

The Boss-equivalent metric returns 1.0 per copy for a printed Boss's Orders supporter and a value derived from charges = min(evolution, body) for the Ledian line; removing one Ledian reduces it by one marginal charge, not to zero.
Human: the table is labelled a fast estimate, not a win rate, and is readable (rank, cut, copies, net, per-ecology deltas).

acceptance_gates.title: Similar mean, lower variance wins the tie
verify: For two fixture lists whose capped Monte Carlo means on a named output differ by less than the documented tolerance, the ranking prefers the list with lower variance / lower brick rate and says so.
Reported means and variances carry the simulation id they came from; no number is produced without a run.
Human: the explanation reads as ceiling / broken chain / variance, not a raw matrix.

acceptance_gates.title: Neighborhood search prunes with delta-S and confirms with capped Monte Carlo
verify: From the Carpet Set G seed and a bounded pool, the search returns at least one legal neighbor (60 cards, copy cap respected) with a written reason from the KG metrics.
When the pool contains a linked higher-quality substitute for an isolated weaker attacker of comparable cost, that swap outranks keeping the junk node unless the trainer locked it.
The response shows delta_s and the confirming Monte Carlo win rate side by side for each surviving candidate; pruned candidates carry delta_s only.
The documented budget (max candidates x games per candidate) is enforced; the search never enumerates the full catalog.
Human: the result is labelled a relative improvement, never 'the best 60'.

acceptance_gates.title: Epic exit
verify: On http://127.0.0.1:8000 with preset s60, load Carpet Set G, read copy ceilings and effective seen cards, KG links and junk flags, and the same-cost quality comparison.
Ask 'what do I cut for Mega Clefable ex?' in chat and in the Lab/deck view; both cite the same per-ecology delta-S table with weights shown.
Compare two neighbors on variance, run a bounded search, accept or reject its suggestion; a capped Monte Carlo of the chosen fate is still available.
Operator confirms app/engine/game.py gained no look-N, no name table for quality, and no score coefficient from this epic.
